# Data Visualization Examples

Charts, graphs, metrics, dashboards.

## Reference Code

## Patterns
- Consistent color palette from theme
- Responsive sizing
- Accessible color contrast
- Legend and label positioning
- Animation on data change

## Considerations
- Use theme colors (not hardcoded)
- Support light/dark modes
- Consider colorblind-friendly palettes
- Mobile: touch interactions for tooltips
